name: Loggerhead sea turtle
desc: Yakushima is the largest nesting ground for loggerheads in the North Pacific. Adults eat jellyfish and shellfish; eggs and hatchlings are eaten by crabs, crows and raccoon dogs.
about: The loggerhead sea turtle, loggerhead turtle or loggerhead, is a species of sea turtle distributed throughout the world. It is a marine reptile, belonging to the family Cheloniidae.
